references.title: DWDS: gesamt
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung; Adjektiv (attributiv); Etymologie: ahd. gisamanōt, the participle of samanōn, no longer read

notes.rationale: der gesamte Nachbaradel, all the neighbouring nobility. en.wiktionary gives only its Middle High German participle, no German split. DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word: the Root gesamt and the zero ending (ADR 0051).
